build_autoencoder_kl_flux2: build an AutoencoderKLFlux2 model with custom latent channels and block output channels for image encoding
encode_images_with_autoencoder_kl_flux2: encode a batch of images into latent representations using the AutoencoderKLFlux2 encode method
decode_latents_with_autoencoder_kl_flux2: decode a batch of latent vectors back into images using the AutoencoderKLFlux2 decode method
tiled_encode_with_autoencoder_kl_flux2: encode large images using tiled encoding to keep memory constant regardless of image size
tiled_decode_with_autoencoder_kl_flux2: decode large latent tensors using tiled decoding to avoid seams between tiles
